steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.endTour?.(); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setLocation?.({ lat: 1.3521, lon: 103.8198, label: 'SG' }); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('medium'); })()

steps.name: place-catb-items
steps.eval: (() => { const s=window.__store.getState(); const Z=-7; const X0=3, DX=4.5; const defs=[ {defId:'dining-table-4',props:{seats:'6',shape:'rect',leaf:'extended',finish:'wood',topColor:'#a9835a'}}, {defId:'altar-cabinet',props:{width:0.9,style:'cabinet',color:'#7a3b2e'}}, {defId:'banquette',props:{width:1.6,material:'boucle',color:'#cbb9a2'}}, {defId:'bed-queen',props:{baseStyle:'hydraulic'}}, {defId:'water-heater',props:{width:0.5,mountHeight:1.5,color:'#f2f2ee'}}, {defId:'fluted-partition',props:{width:1.4,height:2.1,frameColor:'#2b2b2b',glassColor:'#dfe7e6'}} ]; const items=defs.map((d,i)=>({id:'catb-'+i,defId:d.defId,position:[X0+i*DX,Z],rotation:0,props:d.props})); window.__catb={items:items.map(it=>({id:it.id,x:it.position[0],z:it.position[1],defId:it.defId}))}; s.setItems(items); return window.__catb.items.map(i=>i.defId); })()

steps.name: cam-dining
steps.eval: (() => { const it=window.__catb.items[0]; const c=window.__three.controls, cam=window.__three.camera; cam.position.set(it.x+1.4, 1.3, it.z+3.0); c.target.set(it.x, 0.45, it.z); c.update(); return it.defId; })()
